fullReads.path: 00 Учебник/06 Encoder, Decoder и Encoder-Decoder/03 BERT, RoBERTa и DeBERTa.md
fullReads.read: complete saved chapter including frontmatter, all explanations, programs, figures/captions, sources and navigation
findings: The previous architecture-pattern chapter supplies MLM versus NTP. BERT then develops input assembly, the two heads, both losses and one actual update before task-specific use.
RoBERTa changes data/optimization; SpanBERT and SOP alter target construction; DeBERTa follows the earlier positional-information prerequisite. These are not presented as one unqualified improvement.

fullReads.path: 00 Учебник/06 Encoder, Decoder и Encoder-Decoder/04 GPT-1 — генеративное предобучение.md
fullReads.read: complete saved chapter including frontmatter, all explanations, programs, figures/captions, sources and navigation
findings: Supervised task heads and updates are separated from heuristic zero-shot scoring. Candidate loss and token-loss normalization have worked examples.
Post-norm and the historical combined embedding table are distinguished from GPT-2 pre-norm and the teaching model; no modern Llama components are retroactively attributed to GPT-1.

fullReads.path: 00 Учебник/06 Encoder, Decoder и Encoder-Decoder/05 GPT-2 — zero-shot через язык.md
fullReads.read: complete saved chapter including frontmatter, all explanations, programs, figures/captions, sources and navigation
findings: The GPT-1 transition changes task interface and normalization while retaining NTP. Input bytes, positions, logits, sampling and cache are developed in order.
Full-cache versus delta-cache contracts, P+G-1 and demonstration-based translation are explicit. The historical zero-shot label is distinguished from today's shot count.

fullReads.path: 00 Учебник/06 Encoder, Decoder и Encoder-Decoder/06 GPT-3 — in-context learning.md
fullReads.read: complete saved chapter including frontmatter, all explanations, programs, figures/captions, sources and navigation
findings: GPT-2 supplies prompt continuation and cache; GPT-3 develops fixed-weight demonstrations, complete candidate scoring and its protocol-dependent normalization.
T5 follows as an architectural comparison, not a chronological claim. Two retained paper images explicitly lack confirmed reproduction permission; that remains a release issue.

fullReads.path: 00 Учебник/06 Encoder, Decoder и Encoder-Decoder/07 T5 — text-to-text Transformer.md
fullReads.read: complete saved chapter including frontmatter, all explanations, programs, figures/captions, sources and navigation
findings: Source and target are separated before self/cross-attention, PAD-ID decoder start, label shifting and span corruption.

RMS-style normalization and relative buckets prepare the LLaMA comparison. Source reuse and decoder caches are distinguished from causal-prefix reuse. Fresh CPU execution was unavailable because SentencePiece was not cached.
